tools.name: execute_python_script
tools.description: Write and execute a Python script natively via Unreal's Python Editor Script Plugin. The script runs in-process with full access to the 'unreal' module. WARNING: This tool is a last resort. Do NOT use this tool for spawning actors, asset searches, modifying Blueprints, or editing levels if a native tool or dedicated skill exists. You must provide a detailed explanation of why specific native tools/skills are insufficient.

script.description: The Python script source code to execute. Has access to the 'unreal' module for all editor APIs. Print statements are captured as output. Example: 'import unreal\nasset_tools = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()\nprint("Asset tools ready")'

justification_why_native_tools_or_skills.description: Detailed explanation of why specific native tools (e.g. blueprint_tools, level_tools, widget_tools, etc.) or dedicated skills (e.g. blueprint-authoring, create-actor) cannot be used to perform this operation. Using Python scripting to bypass dedicated tools or skills is strictly forbidden.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (5-120, default 30). Script is terminated if it exceeds this limit.
